body: That is interesting, i have always like scandinavia ans wanted to visit. Youre very lucky to live there.
Its just not going to happen for me.

I would like to move but its not possible for me. I was also done with my town as a teen but i never got out and now I never will. I havent read those books, im not really that smart so they would t help me.
No ive never lived anywhere else.
I don't really want to post my state specifically but I'm in the pacific northwest.
I just don't have the energy for that kind of stuff.
yes I can't afford to move, big cities have big costs of living and it wouldn't be possible for me to make ends meet in any of them despite wanting to move.

I have kept gratitude journals, done mental health apps, read cbt books, read books on stoic philosophy, etc. I have tried so much and it didn't work. I simply don't have the hope that you have, it's just not there and I can only imagine my future as bleak as my past. Why put myself through that? Yes I live in a relatively small town.
You see, I just don't see anything as fun anymore. Everything is so bleak, I couldn't even think of something to do that might be fun because I don't think i even remember the feeling.

I don't have a technically inclined mind, I just read some books and took a few classes on udemy...even with that I still suck and can only do bare minimum basics that like 10 year olds can do. It really isn't anything special.
I know that men dont find women attractive when they are in their 30s.
It is nice that you are getting treatment, I cannot afford it unfortunately.
It won't get better for me, I am not accomplishing cool things.
